data.name: AlphaHelpText
data.value:
Alpha Syntax Help =================
Basic rules ----------- <> commands are placed on the chart timeline and do not consume comma time slots. Available note types: tap, each, hold, slide, star, break, touch, and touchhold. Per-type values override global values; use NULL to restore the inherited value. Durations accept seconds or beat lengths such as 8:1 and 16:1. Beat lengths use the latest BPM before the command, with the same conversion as Slide durations. When a parameter is empty, Tab inserts its recommended default. Otherwise, Tab moves to the next parameter.
Meter, background, and comments ------------------------------- @4/4 Set 4/4 meter @3/4 Set 3/4 meter @start Mark media trim start (standalone line) @end Mark media trim end (standalone line) @FF00FF Tint the following editor area @NULL Clear the editor background tint || Measures 1-4 Line comment |* block comment *| Block comment
Note color and opacity ---------------------- <COLOR*FF00FF> Color all following notes <COLOR*tap=FF77AA,slide=66DDFF> <COLOR*NULL> Restore every default color <COLOR*tap=NULL> Restore Tap only <ALPHA*0.5> Opacity for every note, from 0 to 1 <ALPHA*tap=0.4,slide=0.8> <ALPHA*NULL> <ALPHA*tap=NULL>
Note size --------- <SIZE*1.25> Scale regular notes and star heads, but not Slide bodies <SIZE*(1.2,0.8)> Set local X and Y scales separately <SIZE*tap=(1,2)> Change only the Tap X and Y scales <SIZE*tap=0.9,star=1.2> <SIZE*slide=1.25> Scale Slide bodies only <SIZE*hold=(1.1,0.8),touch=0.9> <SIZE*NULL> <SIZE*tap=NULL> <SIZE*slide=NULL>
Speed ----- <SV*2> True scroll-speed multiplier <SV*tap=1.5,slide=0.8> <SV*tap=NULL> Make this type inherit the global SV again <HS*1.2> Traditional fall-speed multiplier <HS*hold=0.8,star=1.4> <HS*hold=NULL>
Judge line and display ---------------------- <JLINE*00FF00> Change the judge-line color immediately <JLINE*(00FF00,0.3)> Transition over 0.3 seconds <JLINE*(00FF00,8:1)> Transition over an eighth note at the current BPM <JLINE*NULL> Restore the skin's default color Display commands change immediately when the final transition duration is omitted. Durations also accept 8:1, 16:1, and similar beat lengths. <ShowJudgeLine*(False)> <ShowJudgeLine*(False,1)> <ShowJudgeLine*(False,8:1)> <ShowJudgeArea*(True,1)> <ShowJudgeText*(False,1)> <ShowJudgeInfo*(False,1)> <ShowComboInfo*(False,1)> <InnerBrightness*(0.5,1)> <OuterBrightness*(0.8,1)> <ComboDisplay*(combo,0)>
Captions -------- <TEXT*Hello> Keep until the next TEXT command <TEXT*(Hello,2)> Show for 2 seconds <TEXT*(Hello,16:1)> Show for one sixteenth note at the current BPM <TEXT*> Clear the caption
Media ----- Paths are relative to the chart folder and may use subfolders. Media events are not drawn on the waveform. <AUDIO*(True,media/voice.ogg)> Play one OGG, WAV, or MP3 file <AUDIO*(False)> Stop the current extra audio early <PVOVERLAY*(True,media/cutin.mp4)> Temporarily cover the chart PV with PNG, JPG, or MP4 <PVOVERLAY*(False)> End the overlay early and restore the chart PV MP4 restores the PV when playback ends. A still image remains until False or chart stop.
Screen effects -------------- General rule: True enables and holds an effect; False disables it. The final [transition duration] is optional. A missing transition switches immediately. Durations accept seconds or beat lengths such as 8:1 and 16:1. Effects with different names can be layered. Repeating True transitions from the current state to the new target. Gaussian <Gaussian*(True,strength[,duration])> Gaussian blur Neon <Neon*(True,strength[,duration])> RGB split and edge glow Trail <Trail*(True,strength[,duration])> Previous-frame trail Fade <Fade*(True,strength[,duration])> Fade toward black Flash <Flash*(True,strength[,duration])> Flash toward white Brightness <Brightness*(True,strength[,duration])> Increase brightness Saturation <Saturation*(True,strength[,duration])> Desaturate Contrast <Contrast*(True,strength[,duration])> Increase contrast Rainbow <Rainbow*(True,strength[,duration])> Animated rainbow blend Vignette <Vignette*(True,strength[,duration])> Shrink the circular visible area Zoom <Zoom*(True,scale[,duration])> Zoom around the center Glitch <Glitch*(True,strength[,duration])> Horizontal segment displacement TVNoise <TVNoise*(True,strength[,duration])> Scan lines and noise Hue <Hue*(True,degrees[,duration])> Rotate hue Tint <Tint*(True,RRGGBB,strength[,duration])> Blend toward a color Move <Move*(True,dx,dy[,duration])> Move the frame Rotate <Rotate*(True,degrees[,duration])> Rotate around the center Shake <Shake*(True,strength,frequency[,degrees,duration])> Shake the frame (Hz) Every effect is disabled with <Effect*(False[,duration])>.
Note modifiers -------------- 1f Tap fireworks 1hf[8:1] Hold fireworks 1f-5[8:1] Slide-head fireworks 1m Mine note 1d D-area Tap 2dh[8:1] D-area Hold 3d-6d[8:1] D-area Slide
Visual editing -------------- Available only while stopped. Click near or outside the judge line to create a Tap; click inside it to create a Touch. Drag around the outer ring to match a Slide path through the crossed judgment areas. Repeated clicks cycle regular, Break, and Touch combinations. The gesture creates only the Slide path; its duration comes from the editor's duration completion.

data.name: AlphaHelpStructuredText
data.value: # Alpha and Extended Syntax > This page follows the current parser and editor completion. The angle-command order matches completion: Note → Display → Filter → Media. Editor-only markers and extended note syntax appear first. ## 1 Basic rules - Alpha commands use <COMMAND*arguments>. Names are case-insensitive; the uppercase completion form is recommended. - Commands sit on the chart timeline without consuming a comma slot and affect content from that time onward. - True / False controls state. NULL clears note properties that support reset. - Durations accept seconds (0.5, 2) or beat lengths (8:1, 16:3), using the nearest preceding BPM. - Per-type keys: tap, each, hold, slide, star, break, touch, touchhold. A typed value overrides the global value. - Type “<” for categorized completion. Tab fills an empty argument with its default or advances to the next argument. ! Square brackets in this document mark optional arguments only. Do not type them. For example, [,duration] means that the final comma and duration may be omitted. E (120){4}<SV*1.5>1,2,<TEXT*(Chorus,2)>3,4, ## 2 Editor markers and comments ### Line and block comments S || comment text E (120){4}1,2,|| everything after this point on the line is ignored S |* multiline comment *| E |* Commas, notes, and Alpha commands may appear here across multiple lines. *| - “||” ignores the rest of its line. Everything between “|*” and “*|” is ignored while line positions are preserved. - Block comments cannot nest. Without a closing “*|”, everything from “|*” to the end of the file is ignored. ### Waveform meter S @numerator/denominator E @4/4 E @7/8 - Both values must be positive integers. The marker changes the strong/weak beat grid from the current time; it does not change View speed or audio. - A marker must appear at the start of a timing cell before note characters; placing it on its own line is recommended. - Use “@” for meter. A legacy “&” meter may be interpreted as a maidata field after reload and should no longer be used. ### Overlapping note stream S @{division}note stream, E @{4}1h,2h,3h, E {8}1,2,3,4,5,6, - An “@” immediately followed by “{” starts an independent note stream at the current time. It advances by its own division without advancing the main chart clock. - Notes at equal times are merged as Each. The example is equivalent to {8}1h/1,2,2h/3,4,3h/5,6,. - Put the stream on its own line before the main line it overlays. Other @ markers such as @4/4 and @RRGGBB are unaffected. ### Editor background color S @RRGGBB E @3A587A S @NULL - Put the marker on its own line. It colors the following editor region only; @NULL restores the theme. Legacy “&RRGGBB / &NULL” is accepted. ## 3 Extended note syntax ### Non-C-area TouchHold S A/B/D/E area position + h[duration] E B1h[4:1] / E3hf[8:1] - A, B, D, and E areas support TouchHold. The area letter must be followed by a position from 1 to 8. ### Break Touch / TouchHold S area position + b S area position + h + b[duration] E B1b / E3b / Chb[4:1] / B1hb[8:1] - b makes a Touch or TouchHold a Break. h and b may appear in either order. ### Touch Slide S start[-|<|>|^]target[duration] E A1-A3[8:1] / A1<A3<A5[8:1] / 1d-E5[8:1] E A1b-A2b[8:1] / A1!-A2[8:1] / A1?-A2[8:1] - A path with an A/B/C/D/E Touch endpoint is a Touch Slide; a normal key or D key may be used at the other end. - b on the head creates a Break head, b after the destination creates a Break path, and ! or ? removes the head. Duration is required. ### Mine, D-zone, and modifier placement S m = gray Mine; d = D-zone position E 1m / 2hm[8:1] / 3d / 4dh[8:1] / 5d-1d[8:1] - On Slides, placement matters: 1m-5 colors only the head, 1-5m colors only the path/moving star, and 1m-5m colors both. - A d after the start key selects the D-zone start; a d after the Slide target selects the D-zone end. ### rp / rq reverse-arc Slides S startrptarget[duration] / startrqtarget[duration] E 1rp3[8:1] / 1rq7[8:1] - rp and rq travel opposite to the pp and qq arc directions. ## 4 Note Alpha commands ### SV — true scroll velocity S <SV*multiplier> S <SV*type=multiplier,type=multiplier> S <SV*type=NULL> E <SV*1.5> / <SV*tap=2,hold=0.75> / <SV*tap=NULL> - Global SV accepts positive, zero, and negative values. Typed NULL makes that type inherit global SV again. ### HS — traditional fall speed S <HS*multiplier> S <HS*type=multiplier,type=multiplier> S <HS*type=NULL> E <HS*1.2> / <HS*star=1.6,hold=0.8> / <HS*hold=NULL> - HS changes the traditional appearance/fall multiplier. Typed NULL clears that type's extra multiplier. ### SPAWN — ring-note visual spawn radius S <SPAWN*radius> S <SPAWN*type=radius,type=radius> S <SPAWN*NULL> / <SPAWN*type=NULL> E <SPAWN*1.225> / <SPAWN*0> / <SPAWN*4.8> / <SPAWN*-4.8> E <SPAWN*tap=-4.8,hold=0> / <SPAWN*tap=NULL> - Radius ranges from -4.8 to 4.8: 1.225 is the original position, 0 is center, 4.8 is the near judge line, and -4.8 is the opposite judge line. - Changing radius automatically changes first-visible and movement-start times. SV × HS still determines actual speed, the final judgment key remains unchanged, and the guide line preserves that target as a reference. - Applies to Tap, Hold, Star heads, Each, and Break ring notes. Touch, TouchHold, and Slide paths are unchanged. ### BOUNCE — judge-line round trip S <BOUNCE*duration> S <BOUNCE*type=duration,type=duration> S <BOUNCE*NULL> / <BOUNCE*type=NULL> E <BOUNCE*8:1> / <BOUNCE*tap=8:1,hold=4:1> / <BOUNCE*NULL> - By default, Tap, Star, Each, and Hold travel from the judge line to the SPAWN radius, stop there, then return for judgment. - Duration accepts seconds or beat ratios. Per-type values override the global value. BOUNCE changes only the visual path and never activates judgment early. ### COLOR — note color S <COLOR*RRGGBB> S <COLOR*type=color,type=color> S <COLOR*NULL> / <COLOR*type=NULL> E <COLOR*FF6699> / <COLOR*tap=FF77AA,slide=66DDFF> / <COLOR*tap=NULL> / <COLOR*NULL> - The global value affects following notes; typed values win. Colors must use six-digit RGB. ### SIZE — note scale S <SIZE*scale> / <SIZE*(scaleX,scaleY)> S <SIZE*type=scale> / <SIZE*type=(scaleX,scaleY)> S <SIZE*NULL> / <SIZE*type=NULL> E <SIZE*1.2> / <SIZE*(1.2,0.8)> / <SIZE*tap=(1,1.5),star=0.9> E <SIZE*slide=1.25> / <SIZE*slide=NULL> / <SIZE*NULL> - Global SIZE scales regular notes and star heads, not Slide paths. Use slide= to scale paths. ### ALPHA — note opacity S <ALPHA*0..1> S <ALPHA*type=0..1,type=0..1> S <ALPHA*NULL> / <ALPHA*type=NULL> E <ALPHA*0.5> / <ALPHA*tap=0.4,slide=0.8> / <ALPHA*tap=NULL> ## 5 Display Alpha commands ### JLINE — judge-line color S <JLINE*RRGGBB> / <JLINE*(RRGGBB[,transition])> / <JLINE*NULL> E <JLINE*00FF00> / <JLINE*(FF6699,0.3)> / <JLINE*(FFFFFF,8:1)> / <JLINE*NULL> - NULL restores the skin color. This changes the judge line during playback. ### TEXT — top-left caption S <TEXT*content> / <TEXT*(content[,duration])> E <TEXT*Chorus> / <TEXT*(Watch the double,2)> / <TEXT*(Final section,16:3)> - Without duration it remains until the next TEXT. With duration it disappears automatically. A final recognizable time after the last comma is used as duration. ### Visibility switches S <ShowJudgeLine*(True|False[,transition])> S <ShowJudgeArea*(True|False[,transition])> S <ShowJudgeText*(True|False[,transition])> S <ShowJudgeInfo*(True|False[,transition])> S <ShowComboInfo*(True|False[,transition])> E <ShowJudgeLine*(False,8:1)> / <ShowJudgeArea*(True,0.5)> E <ShowJudgeText*(False)> / <ShowJudgeInfo*(False,1)> / <ShowComboInfo*(True,1)> - Omitting transition switches immediately. The commands control the line, area, judgment text, left statistics, and right combo panel respectively. - ShowJudgeArea opacity is capped by ShowJudgeLine; when the judge line is hidden, the judge area is also invisible. ### ComboDisplay — center indicator S <ComboDisplay*(mode[,transition])> E <ComboDisplay*(Combo,0)> / <ComboDisplay*(DxScore,8:1)> / <ComboDisplay*(None,0.5)> - Common modes: None/Off, Combo, Score, Achievement/Acc, AccDown, DxAcc, DxAccDown, DxScore, CScore, CScoreDedxDown. ### Brightness S <OuterBrightness*(0..1[,transition])> S <InnerBrightness*(0..1[,transition])> E <OuterBrightness*(0.8,8:1)> / <InnerBrightness*(0.45,1)> - Values are clamped to 0–1: 0 is dark and 1 is full brightness. ## 6 Filter Alpha commands > Common rule: True enables and holds; False disables. The final transition is optional. Different filters can layer, and another True transitions from the current value. S <Effect*(False[,transition])> E <Gaussian*(False,8:1)> / <Move*(False,0.5)> / <Tint*(False)> ### Gaussian / Neon / Trail S <Gaussian*(True,strength[,transition])> S <Neon*(True,strength[,transition])> S <Trail*(True,strength[,transition])> E <Gaussian*(True,1.2,8:1)> / <Neon*(True,0.7)> / <Trail*(True,0.55,0.4)> - Gaussian blurs, Neon adds RGB split and edge glow, and Trail blends previous frames. ### Fade / Flash / Brightness S <Fade*(True,strength[,transition])> S <Flash*(True,strength[,transition])> S <Brightness*(True,strength[,transition])> E <Fade*(True,1,1)> / <Flash*(True,0.8,0.1)> / <Brightness*(True,0.4,8:1)> - Fade darkens, Flash whitens, and Brightness adds light. Fade/Flash commonly use 0–1. - Fade and Flash share one light/dark channel. The later command replaces the earlier one; they do not layer as two independent filters. ### Saturation / Contrast / Rainbow S <Saturation*(True,strength[,transition])> S <Contrast*(True,strength[,transition])> S <Rainbow*(True,strength[,transition])> E <Saturation*(True,1,1)> / <Contrast*(True,0.6)> / <Rainbow*(True,0.5,8:1)> - Saturation 0 keeps color and 1 approaches monochrome. Contrast strengthens contrast; Rainbow adds animated color. ### Vignette / Zoom / Glitch / TVNoise S <Vignette*(True,strength[,transition])> S <Zoom*(True,scale[,transition])> S <Glitch*(True,strength[,transition])> S <TVNoise*(True,strength[,transition])> E <Vignette*(True,0.7,1)> / <Zoom*(True,1.5,8:1)> E <Glitch*(True,0.8,0.2)> / <TVNoise*(True,0.5)> - Vignette shrinks the circular view; Zoom is capped at 8; Glitch displaces horizontal bands; TVNoise adds scan lines and noise. ### Hue / Tint S <Hue*(True,degrees[,transition])> S <Tint*(True,RRGGBB,strength[,transition])> E <Hue*(True,180,1)> / <Tint*(True,000000,1,0.5)> / <Tint*(False,8:1)> - Hue rotates color in degrees. Tint strength 0 preserves the frame and 1 fully blends to the target. ### Move / Rotate / Shake S <Move*(True,dx,dy[,transition])> S <Rotate*(True,degrees[,transition])> S <Shake*(True,strength,frequency[,degrees,transition])> E <Move*(True,0.08,-0.04,8:1)> / <Rotate*(True,-15,0.5)> E <Shake*(True,0.5,12)> / <Shake*(True,0.5,12,30)> / <Shake*(True,0.5,12,,0.2)> / <Shake*(True,0.5,12,30,0.2)> E <Shake*(False)> / <Shake*(False,8:1)> - Move uses positive X for right and positive Y for up. Rotate uses the frame center. Shake frequency is in Hz and strength 1 moves roughly 5% of the frame. Angle and transition are independently optional; leave the angle position empty to set only transition. Omitting angle uses default two-dimensional shake. 0 degrees is horizontal and 90 degrees is vertical. ## 7 Media Alpha commands ### AUDIO S <AUDIO*(True,relative/path.ogg|wav|mp3)> / <AUDIO*(False)> E <AUDIO*(True,media/voice.ogg)> / <AUDIO*(True,se/alert.wav)> / <AUDIO*(False)> - True plays once from the beginning; natural completion stops it, and False stops early. A new True switches to the new extra clip. ### PVOVERLAY S <PVOVERLAY*(True,relative/path.png|jpg|jpeg|mp4[,transition])> / <PVOVERLAY*(False[,transition])> E <PVOVERLAY*(True,media/cutin.png,8:1)> / <PVOVERLAY*(True,media/movie.mp4,0.5)> / <PVOVERLAY*(False,8:1)> - PNG/JPG remains until False or chart stop. MP4 restores the PV when it ends. Consecutive True commands crossfade from the old media to the new media using the requested transition. ! Paths are relative to the chart folder. Absolute paths and “..” are rejected; avoid commas in file names. Media events are drawn on the waveform. ## 8 Editor processing notes - Duration completion offers [8:1], [4:1], [2:1], and [16:3] for Hold, TouchHold, and Slide. [1:0] is only for durationless Hold and is not offered for Slide. - Touch Slide supports A/B/C/D/E zones, connected paths `A1<A3<A5[8:1]`, Break `A1b-A2b[8:1]`, and headless `A1!-A2[8:1]` / `A1?-A2[8:1]`. - “Export chart without effects” removes <> commands, || suffixes, and complete @ lines; the exported copy therefore loses editor meter and background markers too. ## 9 Combined example E (160){16}<COLOR*star=FF66CC><SIZE*star=1.15>1-5[8:1],2,3,4, E <TEXT*(Interlude,2)><Fade*(True,0.65,8:1)><PVOVERLAY*(True,media/cutin.mp4)>,, E <Fade*(False,8:1)><PVOVERLAY*(False)><COLOR*star=NULL><SIZE*star=NULL>,E - Multiple Alpha commands may share one timestamp and consume no extra commas. Keeping Note → Display → Filter → Media order makes charts easier to read and matches completion.
